revisions.description: A tool-calling loop against an OpenAI-compatible model: the model calls declared or MCP tools until it gives a final answer, optionally held to a JSON Schema.

params.label: Model
params.helpertext: The model identifier the endpoint expects, for example openai/gpt-4o-mini.
params.name: model

params.label: Prompt
params.helpertext: The user message. Supports $(params.x) and $(tasks.x.results.y) references. Give this or Prompt file, unless Messages or Messages file replaces both.
params.name: prompt

params.label: Prompt file
params.helpertext: A path on the run workspace whose contents are the user message, for a prompt too large for a param. Give Prompt or Prompt file, not both: neither fails with MISSING_PARAM, both with INVALID_PARAM.
params.name: promptFile

params.label: System prompt
params.helpertext: Sent as the system message ahead of the prompt. Ignored when Messages is given.
params.name: systemPrompt

params.description: [{role, content}]: the exact message array to send, replacing System prompt and Prompt.
params.label: Messages
params.helpertext: A JSON array of {role, content} sent as the exact message array, replacing System prompt and Prompt. For replays and evals. Fails with INVALID_PARAM when it does not parse. Give this or Messages file, not both.
params.name: messages

params.label: Messages file
params.helpertext: A path on the run workspace holding the JSON array of {role, content}, for a message array too large for a param. Give Messages or Messages file, not both; either replaces System prompt and Prompt.
params.name: messagesFile

params.label: Endpoint
params.helpertext: An OpenAI-compatible base URL - OpenRouter, LiteLLM, Azure AI Foundry or Ollama. When absent the executor's default applies: the dispatcher's environment (OPENAI_BASE_URL) for a container run, the embedding product's gateway settings in-process.
params.name: endpoint

params.label: API token
params.helpertext: Bearer token for the endpoint. Blanked on every workspace-scoped read. When absent the executor's default applies: the dispatcher's environment (OPENAI_API_KEY) for a container run, the embedding product's gateway settings in-process.
params.name: token

params.label: Temperature
params.helpertext: Sampling temperature. Lower is more deterministic. Blank sends none, so the provider's default applies; newer reasoning models reject any other value.
params.name: temperature

params.label: Max tokens
params.helpertext: Upper bound on the tokens the model may generate, sent as max_tokens. Blank sends none, so the provider's default applies; a max_completion_tokens key in Request parameters replaces it.
params.name: maxTokens

params.label: Seed
params.helpertext: Optional sampling seed, for endpoints that honour one.
params.name: seed

params.description: An open map passed through to the request as sent; its keys win over the convenience params (temperature, maxTokens, seed), and max_completion_tokens suppresses max_tokens.
params.label: Request parameters
params.helpertext: A JSON object merged into the request as sent: top_p, reasoning_effort, verbosity, max_completion_tokens, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty and so on. A key here wins over Temperature, Max tokens and Seed. Fails with INVALID_PARAM when it does not parse.
params.name: parameters

params.label: Response format
params.helpertext: Ask the model for free text or a JSON object.
params.name: responseFormat

params.label: JSON Schema
params.helpertext: A JSON Schema object. With Response format json, the reply is held to it (response_format json_schema, strict) and validated before it is returned.
params.name: jsonSchema

params.label: Files
params.helpertext: Comma-separated paths on the run workspace, read into the prompt context.
params.name: files

params.label: Max context bytes
params.helpertext: Byte budget for the files read into context. Reading stops at the budget.
params.name: maxContextBytes

params.label: Output file
params.helpertext: A path on the run workspace to write the full reply to, for a following uploadartifact node. The output result still carries the reply up to the results cap.
params.name: outputFile

params.description: [{name, description, inputSchema}]: tools served by an MCP server on a container run, or natively by an executor that implements them.
params.label: Tools
params.helpertext: A JSON array of {name, description, inputSchema} tools the executor implements natively. A container run cannot resolve these and fails with UNKNOWN_TOOL before the first call unless each name is served by an MCP server below.
params.name: tools

params.description: [{name, url}]: MCP servers whose tools the agent may call. No credential field; see MCP tokens.
params.label: MCP servers
params.helpertext: A JSON array of {name, url} MCP servers whose tools the agent may call. Never put a credential here: a token comes from MCP tokens below, keyed by server name, or from the executor's default for that name.
params.name: mcpServers

params.description: {serverName: token}: bearer tokens for the MCP servers, keyed by server name.
params.label: MCP tokens
params.helpertext: A JSON object of {serverName: bearerToken} for the MCP servers above. Password-typed, so it is blanked on read and never logged.
params.name: mcpTokens

params.description: [name]: the tool names the model may call; blank allows every declared tool.
params.label: Allowed tools
params.helpertext: A JSON array of tool names the model may call. Blank allows every tool declared above.
params.name: allowedTools

params.description: An opaque object handed to executor tools on every call and never shown to the model.
params.label: Tool context
params.helpertext: A JSON object of opaque values handed to executor tools on every call and never shown to the model.
params.name: toolContext

params.label: Max turns
params.helpertext: Model calls before the loop stops with MAX_TURNS_EXCEEDED.
params.name: maxTurns

params.label: Max tool calls
params.helpertext: Tool calls in total before the loop stops with MAX_TURNS_EXCEEDED. Blank is no limit beyond Max turns.
params.name: maxToolCalls

params.label: Parallel tool calls
params.helpertext: Let the model request several tool calls in one turn.
params.name: parallelToolCalls

params.label: Tool result reinforcement
params.helpertext: Appended as a user message after the tool results on every turn, to keep the model on task.
params.name: toolResultReinforcement

results.description: The model's reply: the text, or the JSON string when Response format is json
results.name: output

results.description: Why the model stopped, as the endpoint reported it
results.name: finishReason

results.description: The model the endpoint actually served
results.name: model

results.description: Tokens consumed by the prompt
results.name: promptTokens

results.description: Tokens generated in the reply
results.name: completionTokens

results.description: Prompt plus completion tokens, the value a platform sums to meter usage
results.name: totalTokens

results.description: Reasoning tokens, when the endpoint reports them; empty otherwise
results.name: reasoningTokens

results.description: Prompt tokens served from the provider's cache, when reported; empty otherwise
results.name: cachedPromptTokens

results.description: The call's cost as the endpoint reports it (OpenRouter usage.cost); empty otherwise
results.name: cost

results.description: Model calls made
results.name: turns

results.description: Tool calls made across all turns
results.name: toolCalls

params.label: Max context bytes
params.helpertext: Byte budget for the files read into context. Reading stops at the budget.
params.name: maxContextBytes

params.description: path-or-https-URL[, ...]: workspace paths sent inline as data URLs, https URLs passed through; any other scheme is refused.
params.label: Images
params.helpertext: Images to send with the prompt, comma-separated: paths on the run workspace (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, read and sent inline) or https URLs (fetched by the provider). Attached to the last user message after its text. Needs a vision-capable model. This is a text param, so a presigned URL is stored and shown with the run; put private images on the workspace instead. The agent resends the images on every turn, since they stay in the conversation, so each turn pays for them again.
params.name: images

params.label: Image detail
params.helpertext: How closely the provider looks at each image. Blank sends nothing, so the provider's default applies. Applies to Images only, not to image parts inside Messages.
params.name: imageDetail

params.label: Max image bytes
params.helpertext: Largest workspace image to send, in bytes. A larger file fails with FILE_TOO_LARGE rather than being resized or skipped. Not sent to the provider, and URLs are not checked.
params.name: maxImageBytes

params.label: Output file
params.helpertext: A path on the run workspace to write the full reply to, for a following uploadartifact node. The output result still carries the reply up to the results cap.
